title: Define macOS runnable desktop structure
summary: Added a macOS execution profile and governance artifacts so the installable platform separates local run, internal .app testing, and public signed/notarized distribution readiness.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official Apple, Tauri, and Electron docs were checked before local planning.
phases.notes: Checked signing, hardened runtime, notarization, Gatekeeper testing, app bundle, DMG, and updater references.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.bottleneck_notes: No blocker; existing installable desktop and runtime anchors were available.
phases.notes: Ran memory bootstrap and selected governance mode.

phases.label: Local context review
phases.bottleneck_notes: The request intersects installable desktop, runtime language, CLI adapter, user-flow, and release governance files.
phases.notes: Reviewed platform-desktop-app, memory bootstrap, requirements, persistent instructions, and coordination status.

phases.label: Config and docs
phases.bottleneck_notes: The largest productive step was making the config self-documenting and keeping paired KO/EN docs aligned.
phases.notes: Added macOS execution profile and updated project docs, packaging docs, README, and project requirements.

phases.label: Governance artifacts
phases.bottleneck_notes: Governance mode requires requirements, spec, provenance, plan evidence, request trace, work summary, coordination, omission, grounding, and evaluation artifacts.
phases.notes: Added REQ-WS-069, requirements change/review, spec set, web search record, research note, provenance, plan evidence, mode selection, request trace, and work summary.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Validation is broad because the macOS profile becomes a shared memory anchor and platform release gate.
phases.notes: Ran JSON, config contract, memory bootstrap, unit tests, docs/naming/structure audits, work timer, workspace index, task board, workspace monitor, and workspace health checks.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.bottleneck_notes: Omission and grounding checks are necessary because the task contains external platform-distribution claims.
phases.notes: Prepared omission, grounding, and evaluator inputs and resolved timing schema rework.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: No bottleneck expected; performed after final validation and evaluation.
phases.notes: Commit and push happen at close-out.

bottleneck_notes: The main cost is the durable governance loop required for a cross-cutting platform release rule.
Future actual macOS packaging will likely bottleneck on Apple Developer credentials, signing/notarization automation, and clean Mac smoke-test environment availability.
improvement_candidates: Create a future deterministic macOS release readiness checker after Tauri scaffolding exists.
